description_en: Calls GetNotification to retrieve notification information
name: GetNotification

Category.description_en:
The notification category. Valid values:

GATEWAY_OFFLINE: gateway offline information.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING: join permission authorization information.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED: join permission authorization information.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED: join permission authorization information.
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED: join permission authorization information
Category.description_zh:
通知分类。取值：

GATEWAY_OFFLINE：网关离线信息。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING：凭证授权信息。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED：凭证授权信息。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED：凭证授权信息。
JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED：凭证授权信息

GatewayOfflineInfo.description_en:
The gateway offline information.

This field has a value only when Category is set to GATEWAY_OFFLINE
GatewayOfflineInfo.description_zh:
网关离线信息。

当Category为GATEWAY_OFFLINE时该字段有值

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

OfflineMillis.description_en: The time when the gateway went offline. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OfflineMillis.description_zh: 离线时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳

HandleState.description_en:
The handling status of the notification. Valid values:

HANDLED: handled.
UNHANDLED: not handled
HandleState.description_zh: 此通知的处理状态。可取值为HANDLED(已处理)，UNHANDLED(未处理)

HandledMillis.description_en: The time when the notification was handled. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
HandledMillis.description_zh: 通知被处理的时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳

JoinPermissionAuthInfo.description_en:
The join permission authorization information.

This field has a value only when Category is set to JOINPERMISSION_AUTH
JoinPermissionAuthInfo.description_zh:
凭证授权信息。

当Category为JOINPERMISSION_AUTH时该字段有值

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was approved, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的UNIX时间戳 ，毫秒为单位

ApplyingMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was submitted, in milliseconds
ApplyingMillis.description_zh: 发起工单的UNIX时间戳，毫秒为单位

CanceledMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was canceled, in milliseconds
CanceledMillis.description_zh: 工单被取消的UNIX时间戳，毫秒为单位

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The unique ID of the join permission

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission

OrderState.description_en:
The ticket status. Valid values:

APPLYING: The ticket has been submitted and is pending approval.
ACCEPTED: The ticket has been approved.
REJECTED: The ticket has been rejected.
CANCELED: The ticket has been canceled
OrderState.description_zh:
工单状态。取值：

APPLYING：工单发起，等待批准。
ACCEPTED：工单被批准。
REJECTED：工单被拒绝。
CANCELED：工单被取消

OwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission owner who initiated the authorization
OwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 发起授权的入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID

RejectedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was rejected, in milliseconds
RejectedMillis.description_zh: 工单被拒绝的UNIX时间戳，毫秒为单位

RenterAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission tenant
RenterAliyunId.description_zh: 入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID

NoticeMillis.description_en: The time when the notification was sent. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
NoticeMillis.description_zh: 通知发出的时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
